As Dentaliva, we take care to answer the questions that our valued patients frequently ask us in the most comprehensive way. Our aim is to remove all the question marks in your mind and provide complete transparency about your treatment processes. We strive to ensure that you can easily access accurate and reliable information on every subject you are curious about.

Teeth whitening is performed by applying a whitening gel on the teeth by isolating the gingival. There are 4 types; Home Bleaching (home type) Office Bleaching (applied at the dentist clinic) Bleaching applied to a single tooth, bleaching with the combination of Home and Office type.

A layer containing a creamy microorganism is formed on the surface of the teeth, which we call plaque. If this plaque cannot be removed from the tooth surface by brushing regularly, it hardens and accumulations, which we call tartar or dental calculus, are formed. As long as the tartars formed remain on the tooth, they damage the periodontal tissues.

The healthy gum is pale pink and ends on the surface of the tooth by reseting as a knife edge. The first sign of gum disease is redness and swelling. Then bleeding starts during brushing. This early stage is called gingivitis. If it is not treated, the problem reaches the bone and the bone tissue surrounding the tooth begins to melt. The gingival is recessed with the bone. Tooth roots appear in the mouth and sensitivity develops in the teeth.

A single crown prosthesis (tooth crown) is made on the implant to restore the loss of a single tooth. In cases of multiple tooth loss, a sufficient number of implants can be placed in the toothless area and a fixed prosthesis in the form of a bridge can be made on them.
Discoloration that cannot be corrected by bleaching (root canal treatment, tetracycline or other medications, excess fluoride cause tooth discoloration),
In teeth with diastema (space between two teeth),
In teeth with deformed teeth,
Post-traumatic enamel, enamel-dentin fractures,
Teeth that are not lined up properly, teeth with crowding.
Orthodontic treatment has no age and can be applied at any age. The important thing is to determine the patient’s needs correctly and to apply the right treatment option.

Dentaliva Dental Clinic started its activities in 2012 in Başakşehir, one of the modern districts of Istanbul, with the motto of “For Everyone to Smile” in order to provide you with the best service.

In addition to being a professional in business by keeping comfort and satisfaction in the foreground; It has adopted the principle of providing a comfortable and peaceful environment to its patients with its disciplined, friendly staff and providing quality service with its experienced and specialist physicians.
Dentaliva Dental Clinic, which has been continuing its service since 2012 in order to appeal to every audience and need, continues to grow with its expert staff and highly motivated team.
In this context, we opened our 2nd branch of “Private Avcılar Dentaliva Oral and Dental Health Polyclinic” in Avcılar and our 3rd branch in Altunizade on the Anatolian Side.
Our Avcılar branch has 5 floors and provides you with the best comfort with many facilities such as 7 patient units, male-female mosque, baby care room, children’s playground to ensure your comfort.
Our Altunizade branch provides you with the best comfort with 5 patient units, a prayer room for men and women, and a playground for children.
Invisalign treatment (Wireless Orthodontic Treatment),
Oral, Dental and Maxillofacial Surgery,
Periodontology (Gum Treatments),
Pedodontics (Pediatric Dentistry),
Laminate Veneer (Porcelain Lamina Dental Treatment),
Endodontics (Canal Treatment)
Dentaliva Dental Clinic Avcılar branch is on weekdays and Saturdays at 09:00/23:00,
Our Altunizade branch is on weekdays and Saturdays at 09:00/21:00,
Our Başakşehir branch also provides service between 09:00 and 23:00 on weekdays and Saturdays, and between 10:00 and 20:00 on Sundays.

With the “Dentaliva Academy” we have established within our organization, it continues to offer you better by receiving valuable trainings from the professionals in the field in order to contribute to the professional and personal career of its team on a monthly basis.
